g.title: b2_passes
g.text: Where the side-car enters the refiner, pass by pass, and which loss trains each write
grey: the release · green: the read (adapter) and what trains · red: the planning loss on proposals · amber: the score loss on the pick

g.title: mtd
g.text: the planning loss (mtd_loss), on p₁ … p₄
winner-takes-all L1 (x, y, heading): the proposal nearest the human is pulled to it
+ 0.5 × the same toward up to 4 good anchors (teachers)
each earlier pass discounted × 0.1 (p₃ 0.1, p₂ 0.01, p₁ 0.001)
no NC or TTC term; it trains δ₁ … δ₃, never δ₄

g.title: score
g.text: the score loss, on the pick
BCE of each proposal's final score against its PDM score
the release trained it jointly: it reaches q₄, so δ₄,
and through the shared weights every pass

g.title: recipes
g.text: so, by recipe, the side-car's route into the pick (δ₄) is trained by
the score loss, at every step, with the planning loss and the auxiliaries
stage 1 (planning loss) leaves δ₄ untrained for scoring; stage 3 trains
a pass-4-only copy of the read with the scorer, on the score loss, passes 1–3 frozen,
so p₄ and its labels stay exactly as dumped
without stage 3's copy, a two-stage recipe would test imitation, not choosing
